comparison_scope: Contract-level overlap check against the closest current evidence, publication-metadata, and review-record tools. No matched same-task outcome, cost, reliability, or maintenance-burden trial has been run.

compared_tools.observed_contract: Validates one fixed evidence-program tree, preregistration ordering, provenance fields, threshold consistency and metric leakage; it does not compare successive claim-evidence snapshots or acquisition dependence.

Compares title and publication year across one Crossref and one OpenAlex result for the same DOI; it does not report claim-scope, evidence-item, stopping-policy, evaluator or source-family changes across time.
Compares two audit finding sets under the same scope, target and target revision; it does not compare scientific evidence acquisition histories or update policies.

Repository change-triggered source-asset lineage uses a fixed SOURCE_ASSET_CHANGED state and re-review limitation; it is not a task-paired update snapshot comparator and does not bind acquisition/stopping/evaluator controls.

distinct_function: Compares two bounded caller-supplied snapshots for one stable task ID and claim ID, preserving predecessor/as-of identity.
Reports exact evidence-ID additions, absences, retained record digests, declared record-state changes and source-family count deltas.
Surfaces scope/applicability changes, task revision drift, evaluator/update/stopping-policy drift and acquisition dependence; missing controls produce COMPARISON_UNKNOWN.
Provides EXPLICIT_NO_CHANGE only when all compared metadata is present and equal. Unknown metadata produces NO_CHANGE_NOT_ESTABLISHED rather than an empty success.
Reports explicit caller-declared withdrawal/retraction transitions as review triggers; absence from a later snapshot is not treated as withdrawal.
claim_ceiling: Structural caller-record comparison only. No source authentication, evidence-quality judgment, claim-truth decision, downgrade inference, accumulation-bias measurement, scientific acceptance, or state mutation.
unique_remaining_use_cases: Produce an explicit, machine-readable as-of evidence update trace for one claim while keeping source-family, scope, evaluator, stopping-policy, acquisition-dependence, and uncertainty changes visible.
retirement_decision: NONE. Current neighbors cover different input/output contracts. No evidence supports retiring or replacing any operation; preserve COMPARISON_UNKNOWN pending a low-cost matched-task trial.
